title: 将二叉搜索树变平衡
summary: 把给定二叉搜索树重构为高度平衡的二叉搜索树，节点值保持不变。
insight: BST 中序遍历得到有序值数组；每次选择区间中点为根，递归构造左右半区即可保证高度差不超过一。
pitfalls: 中序序列必须保持全部节点
构造区间为空时返回 null
题目允许多种平衡答案，本实现固定选择左中点

solutions.title: 中序序列分治重建
solutions.idea: 先排序化节点值，再按中点递归构造。
steps: 中序 DFS 把值加入 values
build(left,right) 选 middle=(left+right)/2 创建根
递归连接左右区间并返回 build(0,n-1)

code.java: class Solution { private final List<Integer> values=new ArrayList<>();private void inorder(TreeNode node){if(node==null)return;inorder(node.left);values.add(node.val);inorder(node.right);}private TreeNode build(int left,int right){if(left>right)return null;int middle=left+(right-left)/2;TreeNode root=new TreeNode(values.get(middle));root.left=build(left,middle-1);root.right=build(middle+1,right);return root;}public TreeNode balanceBST(TreeNode root){inorder(root);return build(0,values.size()-1);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private val values=mutableListOf<Int>();private fun inorder(node:TreeNode?){if(node==null)return;inorder(node.left);values.add(node.`val`);inorder(node.right)};private fun build(left:Int,right:Int):TreeNode?{if(left>right)return null;val middle=left+(right-left)/2;val root=TreeNode(values[middle]);root.left=build(left,middle-1);root.right=build(middle+1,right);return root};fun balanceBST(root:TreeNode?):TreeNode?{inorder(root);return build(0,values.lastIndex)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> values;void inorder(TreeNode* node){if(!node)return;inorder(node->left);values.push_back(node->val);inorder(node->right);}TreeNode* build(int left,int right){if(left>right)return nullptr;int middle=left+(right-left)/2;TreeNode* root=new TreeNode(values[middle]);root->left=build(left,middle-1);root->right=build(middle+1,right);return root;}public:TreeNode* balanceBST(TreeNode* root){inorder(root);return build(0,values.size()-1);} };
